slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation, the author's analysis) states that rural primary schools in Benin predominantly record attendance and administrative data on paper call registers, and that it found no evidence of digital entry at rural school level, scoring Benin schools 1; the statement is undated, so the document's publication date is used.
facts.system: paper registers (no system named at school level)

systems.country_label: EMIS; statistical yearbooks produced by INFRE
systems.tiers: national; the document says collection is likely on paper and aggregated upward
schools in Atacora and Atlantique, filled weekly from the registers

note: The paper fact names no system of class emis: it is the dated statement of absence the brief asks for, recorded under the sub-indicator's class. The document does not mention EducMaster.
